text:
anna (People Ops): Thanks again for coming to today’s all‑hands! Quick thread to capture the key links, clarifications, and action owners from the Q&A. :wave:

omar (CEO): TL;DR — invest in reliability/tooling for scale; Dedicated availability in more regions this year; Private deployments are a prioritized enterprise feature but slower rollout.

anna (People Ops): Links: recording -> https://internal.redwood.ai/ah/1987654321/recording ; slides -> https://docs.redwood.ai/ah/q1-roadmap ; follow-up doc -> https://docs.redwood.ai/ah/1987654321-actions (please edit if you’re assigned).

mike (Product): Clarify roadmap ask: Dedicated GA target is Q3, with early access in late Q2 for select customers. Private on‑prem pilot targeted for Q4 (enterprise sales + legal dependency).

sarah (Eng): On latency/cost work: prioritize batching/autoscale improvements (INF-3245) then KV cache persistence (INF-3298). We’ll start a spike next sprint.

lucy (Platform): For Dedicated multi‑region, ops work is INF-3310. Need capacity planning from Sales by 4/30. Assigning follow-up: @mike — get list of pilot customers; @lucy — ops plan.

james (Eng): Small clarification from QA: when you said "fallback policy by default", is that global fallback or per-tenant?

omar (CEO): Good Q — default is global policy with per-tenant overrides. We’ll add config detail to the docs. @sarah can you add sample config snippet?

sarah (Eng): Yup — will add example to the follow-up doc (INF-3333). Snippet will show: 
```
route: { primary_model: "redwood-3b", fallback: "redwood-1b", policy: "latency-first" }
```

anna (People Ops): Action list (owners & ETA):
- Slides + recording posted — anna — done
- Follow-up doc created — anna — done
- Dedicated GA timeline & pilot customers — mike — 2026-06-01
- Multi-region ops plan (INF-3310) — lucy — 2026-05-01
- Latency/cost spike (INF-3245) — sarah/james — 2026-04-15
- Add fallback config examples (INF-3333) — sarah — 2026-04-10
- Sales to provide pilot customer list — sales@ (cc: mike) — 2026-04-30

mike (Product): Note: pricing for Dedicated will be posted in the partner portal. Draft pricing doc -> https://internal.redwood.ai/pricing/dedicated-draft (feedback welcome).

lucy (Platform): Ops note: requirement for HSM integration in Private is still a blocker for some customers — tracking as SEC-210. Legal is on the loop.

james (Eng): Quick ask — can we get a short 15m sync about the autoscale knobs? pinging @sarah and @lucy.

sarah (Eng): Yes; propose 4/5 09:30 PT. I’ll create a calendar invite. :calendar:

omar (CEO): Thanks everyone. Two leadership clarifications from the Q&A: 1) We’re not pausing new feature work — focus is on shipping reliability improvements first; 2) We will offer both hosted-first and enterprise-first paths for customers.

anna (People Ops): If I missed anything, reply here with brief line items and I’ll add to the doc. Otherwise I’ll send a summary email to the company tomorrow. :thumbsup:

allhands-bot: Reminder: company follow-up survey closes in 72 hours — https://internal.redwood.ai/surveys/ah-q2.

mike (Product): +1 — will add the pilot list to the follow-up doc once Sales shares it.

lucy (Platform): :eyes: will review INF-3310 constraints doc by EOD Friday.

anna (People Ops): Closing thread in 48h unless edits — thanks again everyone!
